# Auto-Stop Policy v0.1

Pause affected scope on:
- source SHA mismatch
- accepted artifact corruption
- illegal ledger transition
- repeated canonical commit collision
- E4 fabrication incident spike
- 3 structurally invalid worker outputs on same capsule
- unknown required model identity
- RCU emergency ceiling breach
- inability to reconstruct queue/state from ledger

Local incident is not a global stop unless authority/integrity is systemic.
